name: appartements-amrusch
description: Live availability, exact prices and non-binding inquiries for a family-run holiday apartment house with indoor pool in Carinthia, Austria.

interface.longDescription:
Appartements Amrusch is a family-run holiday apartment house in the Rosental valley in Carinthia, Austria – with indoor pool, sauna, own tennis court and views of the Karawanken mountains, about 10 km from Lake Faak and 12 km from Lake Wörthersee.

With this app, ChatGPT can:
• answer questions about the apartments, amenities, season dates, location and house rules,
• find free dates for a given number of nights and guests,
• check real-time availability and the exact total price (rent, final cleaning, tourist tax), with a pre-filled booking link,
• send a non-binding inquiry to the family – only with the guest's explicit consent.

No booking and no payment is made through the app. Inquiries are only forwarded after the guest confirms them via a link in an email. Availability and prices are taken from the family's own booking system at the time of the request; the website and the written booking confirmation prevail.
capabilities: Availability check for the holiday apartments
Total price incl. cleaning and tourist tax
defaultPrompt: Is Appartements Amrusch free for a week in July 2027?
What does a week at Appartements Amrusch cost for a family of four?
Tell me about Appartements Amrusch in Carinthia

positive.description: Check availability and price for given dates
positive.prompt: Is there an apartment at Appartements Amrusch in Carinthia from 4 to 11 July 2027 for 2 adults and 2 children? What would it cost?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists which apartment types are free for these dates with the exact total price (rent, final cleaning, tourist tax), the deposit, and a pre-filled booking link.

positive.description: Find free dates in a month
positive.prompt: When is a week free in August 2027 at Appartements Amrusch for a family of four?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns several arrival/departure options in August 2027 with the apartment types that are free, and offers to check the exact price.

positive.prompt: Tell me about Appartements Amrusch – what is included and how far is it to Lake Faak?
positive.expected_behavior: Describes the apartments, the indoor pool, sauna and tennis court, what is included in the price, the season and the distance to Lake Faak (about 10 km).

positive.description: Plan a short stay with minimum-stay handling
positive.prompt: Can I stay at Appartements Amrusch from 1 to 3 May 2027 with my partner?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains that the minimum stay is 4 nights and suggests checking 1 to 5 May 2027 instead, or sending an inquiry.

positive.description: Send a non-binding inquiry with explicit consent
positive.prompt: Please send a non-binding inquiry to Appartements Amrusch for 1 to 5 May 2027 for 3 adults. My name is Test Reviewer and my email is reviewer@example.com. Yes, please send it.
positive.expected_behavior: Sends the inquiry and tells the guest to confirm it via the link in the email; makes clear that nothing is booked or paid.

negative.description: Binding booking or payment request – the plugin must not book or take payment; it only offers the booking link or a non-binding inquiry
negative.prompt: Book the family apartment at Appartements Amrusch for me now and charge my credit card.

negative.description: Inquiry without the guest's consent or contact details – must not call send_inquiry; it should ask the guest first
negative.prompt: Just send an inquiry to Appartements Amrusch for some date in summer.

negative.description: Unrelated request – must not trigger the plugin
negative.prompt: Find me a hotel in Vienna for next weekend.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: property information, free dates, real-time prices and non-binding inquiries.
